resources.string: the TV\'s audio output (HDMI ARC or optical)
To list your headphones and to notice when they drop. OK asks.
Opens the TV\'s Bluetooth settings. Put the headphones in pairing mode first.
Pauses what plays and mutes the TV speakers when headphones disconnect, so the sound doesn\'t jump to the room. Unmutes when they\'re back.
Pauses what plays when headphones disconnect. This TV\'s volume is fixed (ARC or an amplifier), so it can\'t also mute the speakers.
Switch it on in the TV\'s settings.
Use the row above to pair some.
Not connected. OK opens Bluetooth settings to connect.
This TV sends sound to one pair of Bluetooth headphones at a time. For two pairs, use a dual-link Bluetooth transmitter on the TV\'s headphone or optical output.
This TV can broadcast to many LE Audio (Auracast) headphones at once: start sharing from the TV\'s Bluetooth settings.
This TV sends sound to one pair of Bluetooth headphones at a time; it has no LE Audio broadcast. For two pairs, use a dual-link Bluetooth transmitter on the TV\'s headphone or optical output.
